description: A photograph depicting a snow-covered green urban area in Täby, Sweden, under a clear blue sky with bright sunlight. The foreground shows several orange-red, spherical ground markers or play elements, and a larger, ring-shaped orange-red structure, all partially covered in snow. A white bicycle with black tires is visible in the middle ground, standing on the snow. The background features a wide expanse of snow-covered ground with scattered deciduous trees, indicating a winter season. This image is credited to K. Larsson.
